summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ongoing share buyback programme. The company repurchased 395,188 to 403,165 ordinary shares daily on XLON from JP Morgan, at prices between 9.8300 and 10.1800 GBP per share, with a volume-weighted average of 10.0722, 10.0899, 9.9288, 10.0794, and 10.0368 GBP across the five days. The shares will be cancelled, reducing the share count. Since the programme's announcement on 6 January 2026, 42,942,499 shares have been bought at 1,097.9568p average. This is a standard on-market repurchase under UK and Hong Kong rules. Watch for further buyback execution and its impact on EPS.
